I’d like to respond to an earlier confession about OP’s struggle dating a nurse. As someone who work shifts with irregular hours, reading this hurts, but it’s a harsh reality, and I think what is most important is that you need to figure out what your priorities are in a relationship. There is nothing wrong about wanting stability, and I don’t blame you for feeling uncomfortable with your partner’s work schedule; it really is something difficult to empathise with. This isn’t unique to nurses. Doctors on call, firefighters, paramedics, even journalists and many others face similar challenges. P
